title: BREAKING: Juan Carlos Rivera-Diaz arrested on alleged felony assault of pregnant person
excerpt: BREAKING: Juan Carlos Rivera-Diaz was arrested Friday at 1:11 a.m. and booked into the Webb County Jail on an alleged third-degree felony charge of assault of a pregnant person. No bond was set. An arrest is an allegation; he is presumed innocent.
content:
LAREDO, Texas — Juan Carlos Rivera-Diaz was arrested early Friday morning, October 23, 2026, and booked into the Webb County Jail on an alleged third-degree felony charge of assault of a pregnant person, according to Webb County booking records.

Rivera-Diaz was arrested at 1:11 a.m. No bond was set, according to the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956.

A third-degree felony in Texas is punishable by two to 10 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Juan Carlos Rivera-Diaz is presumed innocent until proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.

Webb Watch 956
